top_signals.title: Bitcoin surges 12% in two days as Trump, crypto execs lead last ditch effort for Clarity Act
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin is trading at its highest levels since early June as crypto execs joined with President Donald Trump push to get the Clarity Act over the finish line.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Vylor Is Set to Raise $1.1 Billion in Pre-Spinoff Bond Sale
top_signals.summary: Vylor Inc. has launched a $1.1 billion sale of investment-grade bonds that will help finance a payout to parent Corteva Inc., as a spinoff of the seed company nears.
